common.amount_hierarchy: Ordinary routine/history/context use BASE. Explicit challenge motif amount laws above override BASE for those recipes; use the identical law for their matched hard origins except declared historical anchoring, fraction or directional mechanisms. S3,A1,A2,A3 use BASE; N1/N2 use log-uniform USD30..500. All final values constrained to USD0.01..15000 by fresh numerical proposal rejection, then common Decimal half-up cents once. S4/H3 retain exact Stage 15A conditional mixture. For related amount vectors, reject/redraw the entire vector on numerical bound failure, never on a label. Independent shift applied before bounds and rounding: ordinary multiplication1.15, bounded Stage15A transform for S4/H3 only. No double shifting.
common.context: Use all four Stage 15A context roles at probability 1/4 each and its padding/timing rules. Context always uses ordinary BASE amounts including S4/H3. Interleaved activity is counted in the fixed episode budget. No deleted pre-onset events.
common.episode_count: For every family and matched-hard allocation independently, while budget>=12 draw E=DU(12,min(20,budget)); residual<12 moves to routine and is logged. E includes all motif/context rows. For all except N3 set M=E-2 and R=2. For N3 use V/K above and R=E-M (nonnegative for all E). This explicitly replaces Stage 15A count laws for this separate challenge only; original V4 counts remain untouched.
common.prohibition: No generator-to-evaluator calls, forced labels, copied rows, support-driven retries or seed selection. Schedule once before labels; keep every event. Numerical/accounting failures and support failures are different.
common.subjects: Within each unit, independently random-permute active eligible-for-scheduling subjects (activity status only, not target eligibility) for each recipe and cycle without replacement before reuse. Agents similarly cycle. Select counterparties without self-links. No checking observed eligibility or target to accept a subject. Later intervals may revisit subjects; dependent episodes stay in one unit cluster.
common.time: Independent episode start uniform among fitting scored intervals, integer microseconds; uniform motif times within the declared duration, sorted, with first/last at endpoints except explicit order-swaps. No time quota conditioned on labels. Emit before updating state. Temporal support can fail.

Choose chronological order or swap two primary prior edge times with equal probability where at least two exist. Extra-route times uniform before proposed closing instant.
